scenes/augusta_ruin.name: scenes/augusta_ruin

scenes/augusta_ruin.name_in_game: Augusta / Fort Gordon — the first ruin

scenes/bills_house.name: scenes/bills_house
scenes/bills_house.notes: 05.7 / 15.2 — suburban home: the living room with the server rack where Sarah lives, the kitchen, the bedroom, the backyard. Sarah (Part 1, the hologram — 19.0b) walks here; outside she rides Bill's phone.

scenes/cheyenne_approach.name: scenes/cheyenne_approach
scenes/cheyenne_approach.notes: 15.2 Cheyenne Mountain: the blast doors, the tunnel, the server cathedral where Valkyrie *is*. The facility below is the generator's (gen:cheyenne:7 — a fixed seed) with a hand-placed core room (cheyenne_core).

scenes/cheyenne_core.name: scenes/cheyenne_core
scenes/cheyenne_core.notes: 15.2 / plan 4.11: the hand-placed boss room at the bottom of the facility, then the digital dungeon (I-17) in sensor view — node by node; the last room is empty; one server survives. Then I-18 Ashes and Light: Persona Shift unlocks for the

scenes/damascus_compound.name: scenes/damascus_compound
scenes/damascus_compound.notes: I-3 / 2.11 — the first mission, played as Valkyrie in sensor view. Five targets, as the lyric counts them (⚠ the night plan said eight; the song is canon). Greybox city block: no look decided. The song that follows is where the cost lands.

scenes/darpa_lab.name: scenes/darpa_lab
scenes/darpa_lab.notes: 15.1 row 1 / I-2 — institutional cool: the twin bays, the briefing room, Lab 4 (the uncle's), deployment. The wake is a controls lock (04.12); the briefing is the tutorial; Sarah's kill-calculus refusal is her first input.

scenes/dockerys_juke.name: scenes/dockerys_juke
scenes/dockerys_juke.notes: 15.2 Dockery's Crossing: a tin-roofed shack at a Delta crossroads, a generator chugging, Christmas lights, a man with a resonator guitar who has played through every disaster since 1998. Quirk: nobody here believes in Valkyrie. Problem: the

scenes/dry_fork_street.name: scenes/dry_fork_street
scenes/dry_fork_street.notes: 15.2 Dry Fork: one street, one bar, one flag, one sign on the bar door: NO ROBOTS (hand-painted, a year before MEHA makes it law). Quirk: the owner serves Sarah a beer she can't drink and talks for ten minutes about how you can always tell.
scenes/dry_fork_street.name_in_game: Dry Fork, Texas — one street, one bar

scenes/el_paso_bridge.name: scenes/el_paso_bridge
scenes/el_paso_bridge.notes: 15.2 El Paso: two cities, one river, the bridge with its lines of people going south. Quirk: on the Mexican side life continues, and the churro story is already a legend — a man who heard it from a man tells it wrong, and Sarah hears Valkyr

scenes/level_seven.name: scenes/level_seven
scenes/level_seven.notes: 15.2 Level Seven (proposal: the Nevada Test Site): elevators that only go down; fluorescent corridors; Surgical Theater Seven with its gallery. Quirk: the room is built for watching; the game's camera obeys (02 I-15: never the table). New,

scenes/linden_mills_street.name: scenes/linden_mills_street
scenes/linden_mills_street.notes: 15.2 — cul-de-sacs on old farmland, a strip mall (gun store with a bell, a vape shop, the hobby-robotics store), the Sheetz, the Academy, Bill's house on the court. Three states: Peace (Inbox drones on lawns), War (cash only, a National Gua

scenes/mile_212_bar.name: scenes/mile_212_bar
scenes/mile_212_bar.notes: 15.2 Mile 212: a cinderblock bar at a desert exit, forty bikes, a sign that says TRUCKERS WELCOME, SENTINELS NOT. Quirk: the club runs escorts for refugees for gas money — the road's only militia. Problem: an escort that goes wrong; the par

scenes/mont_ross_hangar.name: scenes/mont_ross_hangar
scenes/mont_ross_hangar.notes: 15.1 row 15: Mont Ross — arrival; 'Sarah is home'. Game I ends here (credits placeholder → the title). The runway that submerges is canon (10).

scenes/new_orleans_quarter.name: scenes/new_orleans_quarter
scenes/new_orleans_quarter.notes: 15.2 New Orleans: the Quarter under wartime curfew with every window still lit; brass on the corners; the opera house; the mob's club two blocks off Canal. Quirk: the music never stops (the player learns why the Sentinels never come). The O
scenes/new_orleans_quarter.name_in_game: New Orleans — the Quarter under curfew

scenes/opera_lobby.name: scenes/opera_lobby
scenes/opera_lobby.notes: 14 / plan 4.5: the opera house lobby only — the Opera's logic (I-12b) is a design conversation with William. Posters, the box office, the impresario.

scenes/overture_void.name: scenes/overture_void
scenes/overture_void.notes: I-1 — a black stage for the overture's caption cards (the music, when it exists, is the clock).

scenes/roadside_stop.name: scenes/roadside_stop
scenes/roadside_stop.notes: 2.10 — where a road 'stop' event lands: one placed fight, then back in the car (the trip resumes).

scenes/school_street.name: scenes/school_street
scenes/school_street.notes: Slice A (10.5). Chloe starts bottom-left, walks the south sidewalk to the crosswalk at x=20, is hit in the south lane (row 10), ends up in History 1B (top right). Hedge gap at x=35 is her sneak route to the side door.
scenes/school_street.name_in_game: Act II — the street to school (Chloe)

scenes/tucson_boneyard.name: scenes/tucson_boneyard
scenes/tucson_boneyard.notes: 15.2 Tucson: ten thousand sleeping planes in rows, McKenna's trailer, the shortwave net. Quirk: the parts economy — nothing is for sale, everything is for trade (13.2): the quartermaster prices by Standing. Problem: the shortwave fix (12.5'

scenes/uncle_workshop.name: scenes/uncle_workshop
scenes/uncle_workshop.notes: I-4 — the handover: the chip in the uncle's pocket, young Bill at the window with the phone. A Set Piece with no control (N1); control returns as Sarah, the light, in Bill's room years later.

scenes/washington_mall.name: scenes/washington_mall
scenes/washington_mall.notes: 15.2 Washington — 'power pretending to be calm'. William (2026-11-09): in Act I the Situation Room hack happens from Bill's house, in the same song the body arrives (i11_ghost_in_the_flesh) — the party is never on the ground here in Act I.
